## GitHub Release Notes Template

```markdown
## 🎉 YTBridge v1.0.0

### 🌉 What is YTBridge?
The bridge between YouTube data and your applications. A production-ready REST API built with Clean Architecture and SOLID principles.

### ✨ Features
- 🌉 Universal bridge for all YouTube data needs
- ⚡ Lightning-fast Redis caching (95%+ hit rate)
- 🏗️ Clean Architecture (4 layers, fully testable)
- 🔒 Production-ready (rate limiting, health checks)
- 🐳 Deploy in 30 seconds (Docker Compose)
- 📊 Interactive docs (Swagger UI + ReDoc)

### 🚀 Quick Start
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/ytbridge.git
cd ytbridge
./start.sh
```

Access: http://localhost:8000/api/v1/docs

### 📚 Documentation
- [Architecture Guide](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Deployment Guide](docs/DEPLOY.md)
- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING.md)
- [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)

### 🐛 Known Issues
None

### 📦 What's Changed
- Initial release

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/yourusername/ytbridge/commits/v1.0.0
```

## Docker Hub Description
```
# YTBridge - YouTube Data Bridge

The bridge between YouTube data and your applications.

## Quick Start
```bash
docker run -d \
  -p 8000:8000 \
  -p 6379:6379 \
  --name ytbridge \
  yourusername/ytbridge:latest
```

Access Swagger UI: http://localhost:8000/api/v1/docs

## Features
- ⚡ Redis caching (95%+ hit rate)
- 🏗️ Clean Architecture + SOLID
- 🔒 Production-ready (rate limiting, health checks)
- 📊 Interactive API documentation

## Documentation
GitHub: https://github.com/yourusername/ytbridge

## Supported Tags
- `latest`, `1.0.0`, `1.0`, `1`
- `latest-alpine`, `1.0.0-alpine`

## Environment Variables
See: https://github.com/yourusername/ytbridge/blob/main/docs/DEPLOY.md#environment-variables

## License
MIT - https://github.com/yourusername/ytbridge/blob/main/LICENSE
```
